sources.shortCitation: “Music on the Starlit Water” notice — Variety
sources.fullCitation: [Music note on “Music on the Starlit Water”]. Variety (New York), vol. 120, 27 November 1935, p. 44. Internet Archive / Media History Digital Library.
sources.title: Music on the Starlit Water notice
sources.repository: Internet Archive / Media History Digital Library
sources.researchNote: The item identifies “Music on the Starlit Water” as a Bronisław Kaper–Walter Jurmann tune used as the theme for MGM’s Last of the Pagans and credits Ned Washington with the lyrics.

sources.shortCitation: “Songs Played Over 10,000 Times” — Motion Picture Herald
sources.fullCitation: “Songs Played Over 10,000 Times.” Motion Picture Herald, vol. 124, 5 September 1936, p. 14. Internet Archive / Media History Digital Library; scan contributed by the Library of Congress, MBRS, Moving Image Section.
sources.title: Songs Played Over 10,000 Times
sources.repository: Internet Archive / Media History Digital Library
sources.researchNote: The ASCAP tabulation ranks “You’re All I Need” fourteenth with 21,424 network broadcasts. It prints the source title as Lie Like Gentlemen (Escapade), Walter Jurmann’s surname as “Jarmann,” and credits Bronisław Kaper, Walter Jurmann and Gus Kahn; the publisher is Robbins.

sources.creator: Pax-Film GmbH
sources.title: Der glückliche Herr Fünf advertisement
sources.shortCitation: Der glückliche Herr Fünf advertisement — Der Kinematograph
sources.fullCitation: [Advertisement for Der glückliche Herr Fünf]. Der Kinematograph (Berlin), August 1932, scan leaf 118. Internet Archive / Media History Digital Library.
sources.repository: Internet Archive / Media History Digital Library
sources.researchNote: The advertisement uses the pre-release title Der glückliche Herr Fünf, after Alice Berend’s novel Herr Fünf. It credits Heinz Hilpert as director, Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann with the music, Willi Domgraf-Fassbaender in the leading role, and Pax Film GmbH as producer. The released film is documented elsewhere as Ich will Dich Liebe lehren.
